title: Cu CMP low slurry-flow excursion
symptom: slurry flow trends down, endpoint time extends, and Cu residue rises across several wafers
root_cause: Partial restriction in the slurry filter reduced delivered slurry flow
solution: replace the slurry filter; calibrate the flow controller; run qualification wafers

title: Cu CMP intermittent slurry-delivery loss
symptom: intermittent slurry-flow dips align with removal-rate loss and endpoint extension
root_cause: Slurry pump cavitation intermittently interrupted chemical delivery
solution: inspect pump inlet pressure; remove trapped gas; verify stable slurry delivery

title: Cu CMP radial scratch cluster
symptom: radial scratches repeat at the same wafer radius while normal slurry and endpoint signals are observed
root_cause: A worn retaining ring created repeatable mechanical contact
solution: replace the retaining ring; inspect carrier contact surfaces; verify scratch-free monitor wafers

title: Cu CMP random scratch burst
symptom: random-direction scratches appear on a short wafer sequence after a carrier change with normal process traces
root_cause: A trapped carrier particle caused transient wafer contact
solution: clean the carrier; inspect the load path; monitor subsequent wafers

title: Cu CMP center-fast thickness profile
symptom: post-polish thickness shows a center-fast profile while slurry flow remains stable
root_cause: Pad glazing changed the effective wafer-to-pad contact profile
solution: condition or replace the pad; verify pad-life counters; run profile qualification

title: Cu CMP edge over-polish signature
symptom: edge thickness loss increases after carrier maintenance while center removal remains nominal
root_cause: Retaining-ring pressure calibration was biased high
solution: recalibrate ring pressure; check carrier maintenance records; qualify edge profile

title: ILD CVD low deposition rate
symptom: pre-CMP ILD thickness drifts low on one chamber while downstream CMP traces remain normal
root_cause: The precursor mass-flow controller calibration drifted low
solution: calibrate the precursor MFC; check chamber matching; run thickness qualification

title: CVD chamber particle burst
symptom: particle counts rise abruptly after long chamber runtime and show chamber-specific clustering
root_cause: Deposited film flaked from the showerhead after exceeding clean life
solution: perform chamber clean; inspect the showerhead; reset and monitor clean-life counters

title: PECVD film-stress shift
symptom: film stress shifts tensile while thickness and gas flow remain inside their normal bands
root_cause: RF matching-network drift changed plasma ion energy
solution: verify RF match tuning; inspect reflected power; qualify film stress

title: CVD wafer-to-wafer rate drift
symptom: deposition rate decays over the first wafers after preventive maintenance and then stabilizes
root_cause: The post-clean chamber seasoning sequence was incomplete
solution: repeat the seasoning sequence; verify rate stabilization; review PM completion checks

title: CVD center-edge thickness imbalance
symptom: center-edge thickness range increases with a stable wafer-average deposition rate
root_cause: A heater-zone calibration imbalance changed local surface temperature
solution: calibrate heater zones; verify temperature sensors; run wafer-map qualification

title: Lithography CD large excursion
symptom: critical dimension shifts large together with focus-monitor drift but stable dose monitors
root_cause: Scanner focus calibration shifted after maintenance
solution: recalibrate focus; verify focus-exposure matrix; qualify critical-layer wafers

title: Lithography overlay X shift
symptom: overlay shows a consistent X-direction translation on one scanner with normal wafer expansion terms
root_cause: Stage alignment calibration carried a constant X offset
solution: recalibrate stage alignment; verify alignment marks; run overlay qualification

title: Lithography missing-pattern strip
symptom: missing-pattern defects form a narrow strip aligned with the developer dispense path
root_cause: A partially blocked developer nozzle reduced local chemical coverage
solution: clean or replace the nozzle; verify dispense coverage; inspect monitor wafers

title: Lithography bridge-defect increase
symptom: bridge defects rise while exposure dose is stable and bake-plate temperature trends low
root_cause: Post-exposure bake plate calibration drifted below target
solution: calibrate the bake plate; verify temperature uniformity; run resist-profile qualification

title: Photoresist edge-peel signature
symptom: resist peel is concentrated at the wafer edge after an edge-bead-removal maintenance event
root_cause: The edge-bead-removal nozzle position was misaligned
solution: realign the EBR nozzle; verify edge coverage; inspect adhesion monitors

title: Plasma etch-rate loss
symptom: etch rate trends low with rising source-RF reflected power and stable gas flow
root_cause: Source-RF delivery degraded because of a matching-network fault
solution: inspect the RF match network; verify delivered power; qualify etch rate

title: Etch CD-bias pressure excursion
symptom: post-etch CD bias shifts while chamber pressure oscillates and RF signals remain stable
root_cause: The pressure-control valve response became unstable
solution: service the pressure valve; verify pressure response; run CD qualification

title: Etch residue after early endpoint
symptom: residue rises when optical endpoint terminates early despite normal RF and pressure
root_cause: Endpoint-window coating biased the optical termination signal
solution: clean the endpoint window; verify optical baseline; run residue monitors

title: Etch selectivity loss
symptom: selectivity drops while one chemistry-ratio trace drifts and chamber pressure is normal
root_cause: A reactant MFC calibration error shifted the chemistry ratio
solution: calibrate the reactant MFC; verify gas ratio; qualify selectivity

title: Etch microtrenching increase
symptom: microtrenching rises with elevated bias-RF power while average etch rate stays near target
root_cause: Bias-RF calibration was high and increased directional ion energy
solution: calibrate bias RF; verify profile monitors; qualify trench shape

title: Ion implant dose-low excursion
symptom: sheet resistance shifts high while beam-current dose integration trends low
root_cause: Beam-current calibration understated the delivered dose
solution: calibrate beam current; verify dosimetry; run sheet-resistance monitors

title: Ion implant energy-shift signature
symptom: junction-depth monitors shift with high-voltage ripple while integrated dose remains normal
root_cause: Acceleration high-voltage ripple shifted the implant energy distribution
solution: service the high-voltage supply; verify energy calibration; qualify junction depth

title: Ion implant angle asymmetry
symptom: left-right device asymmetry appears with normal dose and energy monitors
root_cause: Wafer tilt calibration introduced an implant-angle offset
solution: calibrate wafer tilt; inspect chuck alignment; run angle-sensitive monitors

title: Implanter endstation particle event
symptom: backside and edge particles rise on one endstation with normal beam parameters
root_cause: Worn endstation clamp pads shed particles during wafer handling
solution: replace clamp pads; clean the endstation; verify particle monitors

title: Anneal sheet-resistance high
symptom: sheet resistance trends high by furnace run while implant dose monitors remain normal
root_cause: Furnace-zone temperature calibration drifted below the activation target
solution: calibrate furnace zones; verify thermal profile; run activation monitors

title: Furnace oxygen-precipitate increase
symptom: oxygen-related defect monitors rise after a furnace idle period with normal temperature traces
root_cause: A small process-tube leak admitted oxygen during anneal
solution: perform leak check; repair tube seals; qualify oxygen monitors

title: Oxidation edge-thickness shift
symptom: oxide thickness is edge-high across boat positions while average gas flow remains normal
root_cause: Gas-distribution hardware produced a radial reactant imbalance
solution: inspect gas injectors; verify flow distribution; qualify oxide maps

title: Furnace boat-slot periodic defects
symptom: defect counts repeat at fixed boat-slot intervals with stable temperature and atmosphere signals
root_cause: Localized quartz-boat contamination transferred particles to repeating slots
solution: replace or clean the quartz boat; map slot history; run particle qualification

title: PVD metal sheet-resistance drift
symptom: sheet resistance rises gradually with target age while preclean monitors remain normal
root_cause: Target erosion changed deposition-rate uniformity near end of life
solution: replace the target; verify target-life counters; qualify thickness and resistance

title: PVD interface-void increase
symptom: interface voids increase while deposition thickness is normal and preclean RF trends low
root_cause: Preclean RF delivery was insufficient to remove native oxide
solution: repair preclean RF delivery; verify surface-clean monitor; qualify interface integrity

title: PVD chamber particle excursion
symptom: particle counts rise after extended shield life and cluster on one deposition chamber
root_cause: Deposited film flaked from an over-life chamber shield
solution: replace chamber shields; clean the chamber; verify particle qualification

title: PVD left-right thickness asymmetry
symptom: left-right thickness asymmetry increases while average deposition rate remains stable
root_cause: Magnet-scan calibration shifted the plasma distribution
solution: calibrate magnet scan; verify wafer maps; run uniformity qualification

title: Wet-clean watermark excursion
symptom: watermarks rise after spin drying while incoming surface inspection is normal
root_cause: IPA drying flow was below the stable displacement range
solution: restore IPA flow; verify drying profile; inspect monitor wafers

title: Wet-clean metallic contamination
symptom: surface-metal monitors trend high late in bath life with normal incoming wafers
root_cause: The chemical bath exceeded its contamination-control lifetime
solution: replace the bath; review bath-life limits; qualify surface metals

title: Wet-clean oxide-loss excursion
symptom: oxide loss increases with stable process time but abnormal bath-concentration checks
root_cause: Dilute-HF concentration was above its qualified range
solution: restore HF concentration; calibrate concentration measurement; qualify oxide loss
